data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Kareem’, meaning ‘noble’ and ‘generous’. This name is often given to a child born to a blessed family and is a symbol of Allah’s blessings. The name Kareemah carries the meaning “Generous, Blessed, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kareemah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, blessed, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
